title: Sequencing: client migrations
bodyMd:
Five client accounts migrate in successive slots, one account per slot. Each migrates once.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Acorn, Beacon, Crest, Dune, Estuary.

- Crest must be in position 5.
- Acorn must be immediately followed by Estuary.
- Dune must precede Beacon.
